simple.meaning: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יוֹם (H3117) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2304 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
